name: Monster-Mania Con
blurb: A semi-annual horror film and memorabilia convention touring Mid-Atlantic hotels and expo centers, with celebrity guest autographs and photo ops.

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'MONSTER-MANIA 68 OCT. 30 – NOV. 1, 2026 BALTIMORE, MD'; guest page repeats 'OCT. 30 – NOV. 1, 2026' with hotel block 'BALTIMORE HARBOR HILTON 401 W. Pratt St. Baltimore, MD 21201'

Homepage: 'MONSTER-MANIA 69 NOV. 20 -22, 2026 OAKS, PA'; guest page repeats 'NOVEMBER 20 – 22, 2026' with venue block 'THE GREATER PHILADELPHIA EXPO CENTER 100 Station Avenue Oaks, Pennsylvania 19456'

notes: Monster-Mania is one continuously-numbered convention series (MMC 67, 68, 69…) that tours a small set of Mid-Atlantic venues rather than running separate permanent per-city brands, so both upcoming numbered shows are recorded as editions of this one file; MMC 67 (Cherry Hill, NJ — the batch's suggested place — ran Aug 14-16, 2026, already before the research window). Neither guest page's image carousel exposes any caption text/alt in the rendered DOM (every candidate came back with blank text), so every guest name here was read from its photo's own filename instead (e.g. 'Cassandra-Peterson_2026.jpg', 'Matthew-Lillard_2026.jpg'), which is why Known For is left blank throughout per the name-only-card rule; categories are assigned from general knowledge of these public figures (mostly Halloween/Terrifier/Scream-franchise actors). Two entries are lower-confidence: 'Scott Jackson' (filename 'Scott-Jackson-Buz-2025.jpg' has an unexplained extra '-Buz-' token that was dropped) and 'Brian Pekinas' (role unknown). Venue names are my best resolution of the on-page hotel/venue address blocks (Hilton's Baltimore Inner Harbor property at 401 W. Pratt St.; the Greater Philadelphia Expo Center at 100 Station Avenue, Oaks, PA).
